fields.description: Weekly issue featuring local commentary and satire on Greater Miami civic affairs and the post-boom economy. Includes discussion of city commission politics, convention plans, airport planning, waterfront fire protection needs, rents and tourism expectations, banking and publicity spending, Prohibition-era liquor issues and federal investigations, and criticism of a suspected thrown Miami baseball game. Also contains society/gossip columns, entertainment notices, and advertisements for local businesses and real estate.
